scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @estatepm/api" "npm run dev -w @estatepm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @estatepm/api && npm run build -w @estatepm/web
scripts.db:init:docker: docker compose up -d && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate:deploy -w @estatepm/api && npm run db:seed -w @estatepm/api
scripts.db:portfolio: npm run db:properties -w @estatepm/api && npm run db:portfolio:load -w @estatepm/api
